title: update --status done must respect the cascade
description: Found on 2026-11-18 by verifier-ui-runner: its claim of T-488 was refused by the cascade gate because T-487 was not done, yet blackboard.py update T-488 --status done succeeded. A task whose depends_on are not all done must not reach done through update either. Fix in blackboard.py with a regression test; check the verifier_execute_done path, which skipped the claim.
